en: In Wisdom 2, the wicked call our lifetime the passing of what?
In Wisdom 4, what will sway the illegitimate offspring of the wicked?
In Wisdom 4, what will the wicked's offspring never sink deep?
In Wisdom 5, what will be hurled at the wicked, full of wrath?
In Wisdom 6, which consuming vice has nothing in common with wisdom?
In Wisdom 9, Solomon calls himself the son of God's what?
In Wisdom 10, what did wisdom bring Joseph after he was sold?
In Wisdom 10, whose tongues did wisdom make eloquent?
In Wisdom 12, whom did the land's old inhabitants slaughter without mercy?
In Wisdom 12, God gave Israel's ancestors covenants and what, with good promises?
In Wisdom 12, what settlement of God's servants would the precious land receive?
In Wisdom 12, what of the Lord is in all things?
In Wisdom 13, besides fire and wind, which element did men deem gods?
In Wisdom 13, the idol is carved from leftover wood full of what?
In Wisdom 14, to what frail material do sailors entrust their lives?
In Wisdom 15, Israel's oppressors are more foolish than the mind of whom?
In Wisdom 19, instead of fish, what did the river spew forth?
